evidence.title: getmd — Design masterclass for your agents

name: getmd
summary: Library of 73 DESIGN.md design specs extracted from real product websites, ready to hand to an AI coding agent.
description: Browsable library of DESIGN.md files generated from real product websites (Claude, Stripe, Vercel, ElevenLabs, Coinbase …), grouped by industry — AI, fintech, dev tools, productivity and design tools. Each entry pairs a design spec of tokens, typography and component patterns with a live preview of the source site; you download one file, drop it next to your README.md and tell Claude, Cursor or any AI coding tool to use it. Built on Google's DESIGN.md spec.
contains: 73 DESIGN.md files extracted from real product websites
grouped by industry: AI, fintech, dev tools, productivity, design tools
live preview of the source website next to each spec
single-file install: download, drop next to README.md, ask the AI
spec covers design tokens, typography and component patterns
